newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-McConnell Dowell sees solid earnings.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-McConnell Dowell sees solid earnings.

text.p: Construction firm McConnell Dowell Corp Ltd said on Friday that it expected continued solid operating earnings in the year to June 30, 1997.
Earlier the company reported a 66 percent fall in net profit to A$8.75 million in the 1995/96 year.

"The directors believe the company is well placed to continue to win and execute further profitable work in its established markets, and the directors anticipate continued solid operating earnings in the 1996/97 year," McConnell Dowell said in releasing its 1995/96 results.
It said its revenues for the year rose to A$321.76 million from A$315.99 million in 1994/95, while operating profit before abnormals fell to A$11.29 million from A$14.32 million a year earlier.
McConnell Dowell is controlled by Canada's Cedar Group Inc.
